svg.aria-label: Two 8-GPU nodes. Within each node GPUs share an NVLink switch for tensor parallelism. Each GPU connects through a PCIe switch to its own NIC; eight InfiniBand rails connect NIC i on the prefill node to NIC i on the decode node. The CPU is not on the KV path.
svg.title: Two 8-GPU nodes. Within each node GPUs share an NVLink switch for tensor parallelism. Each GPU connects through a PCIe switch to its own NIC; eight InfiniBand rails connect NIC i on the prefill node to NIC i on the decode node. The CPU is not on the KV path.
svg.text: How the KV cache crosses nodes
Each GPU sends its own KV shard through its own NIC and rail. CPU and host memory stay off the path.
not on the KV path (no bounce copy)
KV cache is sharded by TP: GPU i holds KV shard i
